ownership.quote: Scaleway (formerly Online SAS or Online.net) is a French cloud computing and web hosting company, founded by Xavier Niel in 1999 and a majority owned subsidiary of the Iliad group.

stage.quote: a majority owned subsidiary of the Iliad group
stage.note: Scaleway (ex-Online.net/Dedibox) has been built and financed internally within Xavier Niel's Iliad telecom group since 1999; it has not raised independent external venture funding rounds. Iliad itself was a publicly listed company (Euronext Paris: ILD) until Niel took it private in 2021 via a buyout; no evidence Scaleway has separate outside investors.

note: Scaleway (formerly Online.net/Dedibox) is not an independent VC-backed startup: it was founded by Xavier Niel in 1999 and has operated as a subsidiary of his Iliad telecom group (Free, Iliad Italia, etc.) throughout its history, funded via the parent rather than priced external rounds. Buyers should treat its financial backing/stability as tied to Iliad Group, not to standalone startup funding metrics.
